description: Trigger wiring: webhook FAQ branch, cron FAQ job, UNSUPPORTED_RESUME_TYPES, validate_datasource whitelist + public-repo setting-id exemption; is_code_index generalized to the llm_routing family

failing_test.excerpt: ValueError: 'llm_routing_faq' is not a valid CodeIndexType — webhook handle_datasource took the code branch because is_code_index() only excluded llm_routing_google literally
failing_test.note: REAL BUG caught by the test (the analysis's C1 trap family). Fixed at the root: is_code_index() now excludes the whole 'llm_routing' prefix family.

passing_test.note: Covers: validate_datasource accepts FAQ with/without setting_id; webhook dispatches reindex_faq with FaqReindexTask (not 500/code branch); cron schedules the reindex_faq job (no silent no-op); FAQ in UNSUPPORTED_RESUME_TYPES (no stuck-forever); actor builds processor from IndexInfo and runs reprocess; missing-link logs and returns.
